rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty on TE cohesion/uniformity and hatching; the image does not clearly show all the detailed features claimed.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, tubal factor, ovarian response, endometrium, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors, though some numeric adjustments are somewhat heuristic and not tightly evidence-derived.

Mostly evidence-aligned on age-related aneuploidy, obesity risk, and avoiding bed rest, but includes some less guideline-based suggestions (routine estradiol addition, ERA, thaw-biopsy-PGT-A framing, broad RPL workup after a single miscarriage).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer monitoring, luteal support considerations, and future planning, though a few recommendations are more speculative than standard.
